unique_substantive_external_challengers.definition: distinct identities (spec section 10) filing >=1 SUBSTANTIVE challenge (spec section 9) during Stage 0, excluding Federation-affiliated identities (spec section 16)

qualifying_returning_external_challenger.definition: of the above, count who engage again (a further substantive challenge, or an independently loggable instrument-page view) at least N days after their first engagement

secondary_metrics.name: return_engagement_rate
secondary_metrics.definition: qualifying_returning / unique_substantive, published for context only

secondary_metrics.name: challenge_rate_per_instrument
secondary_metrics.definition: substantive challenges per filed instrument, plus zero-challenge instrument count

secondary_metrics.name: process_compliance
secondary_metrics.definition: frozen section 12 Process-Scoring Engine metrics, unchanged

secondary_metrics.name: external_citation_reference
secondary_metrics.definition: privacy-respecting supplemental analytics only; NOT_MEASURED if unavailable

kill_pivot_rule.condition: cumulative unique substantive external challengers = 0 AND no instrument has received any substantive external engagement at all

promotion_methodology.definition: every filed instrument receives the same category of public listing/visibility; no differential promotion

cutoff_gate_ref.formula: CUTOFF_TIMESTAMP = 00:00:00 UTC + 2 calendar days after the LATER of (1) BUILD 03.1 AD-3 -> VERIFIED, (2) this methodology ratification recorded

experiment_dates.note: Per spec section 17 Launch timing: deliberately not selected in this pass. Day 1 begins only after required infrastructure and outstanding production prerequisites (including BUILD 03.1 AD-3 Telegram production-classifier resolution) are ready.

freeze_status_reason: Candidate/source-selection methodology is now RATIFIED (was the prior blocker) but intake has not run and cannot run yet: the frozen cutoff formula requires BUILD 03.1 AD-3 to reach VERIFIED status, which has not happened (governance/gates/build03-1-ad3-status.json remains UNRESOLVED (status field literally reads UNRESOLVED, not VERIFIED — any non-VERIFIED value blocks the cutoff formula identically)). Calendar dates also remain unchosen per the spec's own launch-timing rule. freeze_status becomes VALID only once intake has actually run (producing a populated, non-placeholder candidate-slate.json) and calendar dates are frozen -- neither is authorized yet.
